payload.instructions: Navigate to https://taskip.net/affiliate, complete application form for Taskip, and record status as done.

url_chain: taskip.net/affiliate -> redirected to an unrelated blog article (Affiliate Marketing MOU Template page), not an application form

found 'Become an affiliate' link in the site footer -> https://taskip.net/affiliates/ - 'Earn $1,000+ Monthly with 30% Commissions', 'Become an affiliate' CTA links to https://taskip.affonso.io/onboarding

taskip.affonso.io - Taskip's affiliate program runs on the Affonso platform (a new affiliate-management platform not seen in this backlog before). The auth page (Korean-localized: '제휴 프로그램에 참여하여...') offers only an email field with NO password field at all - 'Create account' ('계정 만들기') and 'Log in' ('로그인') both just take an email and state '로그인을 위한 매직 링크를 보내드립니다' (We'll send a magic link to your email for login) - i.e. a fully passwordless, magic-link-only authentication system.

princess_handoff.reason: Taskip's affiliate program (via the Affonso platform at taskip.affonso.io) never requires a password - but joining requires entering an email and then clicking a one-time magic link sent to that inbox to complete authentication. This is functionally an OTP/email-verification gate, which per the standing butler/princess split is routed to the princess (butler does not have access to the coshuma.com inbox to click the link).
